privileged_info_for_vlm: The loaded file is an X-Ray Angiography (XA) scan, not a CT scan. The initial Window Center and Window Width are NOT 40 and 400; those are incorrect hardcoded fallbacks. The actual initial values are auto-computed by Weasis based on the 0-255 pixel range of the Rubo Medical files. To verify completion, ensure the 'W' and 'L' values displayed in the Weasis UI change from their starting state to any other values that alter the image appearance.
